items.text:
Maya: I adopted a three-legged beagle named Biscuit from the shelter.
Jon: Biscuit is a great name for a beagle.

Maya: I finished my first pottery class and made a blue ceramic bowl.
Jon: A blue bowl, nice work.

Maya: My sister Priya moved to Lisbon for a job at a design studio.
Jon: Lisbon is lovely, she will enjoy it.

Maya: Biscuit learned to fetch a frisbee at the park near the river.
Jon: Clever dog.

Maya: I started volunteering at the riverside animal shelter on Saturdays.
Jon: That sounds rewarding, how is it going?
